name: ICE pair ranker
blurb: Paste both sides' ICE candidates, as SDP lines, a whole offer, candidate JSON or getStats(): the pairs ICE forms, the ones it drops, the order it tries them, and what to fix.

inputs.label: Local candidates
inputs.description: Anything with candidates in it: a=candidate lines, a whole SDP, RTCIceCandidate JSON, or the JSON of getStats(), which holds both sides.
inputs.default:
a=candidate:1 1 udp 2130706431 192.168.1.42 50004 typ host
a=candidate:2 1 udp 1694498815 192.0.2.10 54321 typ srflx raddr 192.168.1.42 rport 50004
a=candidate:3 1 udp 16777215 198.51.100.50 49152 typ relay raddr 192.0.2.10 rport 54321

inputs.label: Remote candidates
inputs.description: The other side's, the same way. Leave it empty when the local box holds getStats() JSON with remote-candidate entries.

inputs.label: Controlling side
inputs.description: The agent that nominates the pair. Its candidates are G in the pair formula, the other side's D.
